disagreements.rationale: One independent solver's private key leaked from a device under outside control and the solver's own inventory left with valid signatures; protocol contracts and user funds were not involved (The Block citing the forensic report).

The sequencer software did not check the minter code of the sending token wallet and minted on TAC against a counterfeit deposit notice; the minted tokens were bridged back to release locked assets on TON (operator post-mortem).
